transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining this planning check-in. As you know, the Product Support and Customer Education teams merged last month, and I'm organizing a two-hour workshop to help both groups establish effective working relationships. Before I finalize the arrangements, I'd like each of you to share any relevant commitments, access needs, or process requirements I should know about. The two available workshop slots are October 9th from 1:00 to 3:00 PM and October 10th from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM. I'm also considering whether to run this in person with a remote participation option, or entirely in person. So please let me know your thoughts and any constraints.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I should let you know — I've already agreed in a separate employee-network planning thread to facilitate the workshop on October 10th from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM, and I won't be able to facilitate the October 9th slot. That agreement wasn't copied into Elena's workshop draft, so I wanted to make sure it's on everyone's radar now.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have an approved hearing accommodation that requires remote participation with live captions and at least 48 hours of agenda notice. I haven't yet requested that this specific workshop use the accommodation, but I'd like to do so now. This means I'll need the remote participation option available, and I'll need the agenda shared at least 48 hours before the workshop date.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I should share some important HR guidance I confirmed this week. A post-merger relationship workshop like this one must not be recorded, must accept anonymous questions, and must publish a written response memo within 5 business days. I haven't yet added this to Elena's draft, but Elena will need to incorporate these requirements before finalizing the arrangements.
